At top of map: Mitchell's military map of the United States, showing forts, &c. with separate maps of states, vicinities of cities &c. Published by S. A. Mitchell, Jr., Philada. Insets: County map of Virginia, and North Carolina. 24 x 30 cm.-County map of Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Maryland, and Delaware. 24 x 30 cm.-[Hampton Roads] 6 x 5 cm.-[Washington, D.C.] 9 x 9 cm.-[Pensacola Bay] 6 x 7 cm.-Map of Charleston Harbor. 6 x 5 cm.-Vicinity of New Orleans, Louisiana. 11 x 9 cm.-Vicinity of Baltimore, Maryland. 11 x 9 cm.-Vicinity of Richmond, Virginia. 11 x 9 cm. Includes population tables. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:10,500,000.
